title: Christian Coworking in Carmel | The Atrium | Vertical Life
description: Faith-minded coworking on N Meridian St near Carmel. Memberships from $150 a month, dedicated desks, private offices and bookable meeting and event space.

blocks.headline: Christian coworking in Carmel
blocks.body: You were never meant to be two people: one version of you on Sunday, another on Monday. The Atrium is where those two finally meet, with businesses, nonprofits and community members working in the same building, on purpose.
blocks.imageAlt: The Atrium at 10330 N Meridian St

blocks.heading: Packages and prices
blocks.body: Solo memberships for one person, and private offices for teams. Every package includes the community.

tiers.name: Tier 2
features: A desk that's yours every day

tiers.name: Private office
tiers.summary: A lockable office for your team
features: Add team members for $100 a month each

blocks.note: Prices are per month. Every office comes with memberships, so you get the room and the community in one package.

blocks.heading: Meeting rooms and credits
blocks.body: Meeting rooms, the production studio and the performance space are open to anyone at public rates. Members book with credits instead of cash.
blocks.note: Members book with credits at $10 each. Credits refresh monthly and don't roll over; add more anytime at $10 a credit. Production studio and performance space bookings follow our booking guidelines.

blocks.heading: Faith doesn't clock out at nine
blocks.body:
Faith-led builders who show up for each other. Not a networking group. Not a small group. A working ecosystem.

Seminars, workshops and the people who make both worth showing up for. Your next collaborator works down the hall.

items.question: How do room credits work?
items.answer: Members book rooms with credits instead of cash. Each credit is $10. Credits refresh monthly and don't roll over, and you can add more anytime at $10 each.

items.question: Can non-members book a room?
items.answer: Yes. Meeting rooms, the production studio and the performance space are open to anyone at public rates: $36, $60 and $125 an hour.

items.question: How big are the private offices?
items.answer: Each lockable office is about 10 by 13 feet. The $850 package includes 3 team members, and you can add more for $100 a month each.

items.question: Are there conference rooms?
items.answer: Our former conference rooms are now meeting rooms, booked with credits like the rest.

items.question: How do I tour the space?
items.answer: Fill out the form on the [visit page](/visit). We'll email the pricing sheet, text you within 2 hours, and send a link to book your tour.

items.question: Where is the Atrium?
items.answer: 10330 N Meridian St, Suite 300, Indianapolis, IN 46290, on N Meridian near Carmel.

blocks.heading: Come and see
blocks.body: Membership starts with a conversation, not a contract. Walk the space, meet a few people and decide whether this is the room you've been looking for.
